additions.title: Theta Functions and Intrinsic Mirrors of Laurent Phenomenon Algebras
additions.summary: We construct bases of upper Laurent phenomenon algebras over a field by minimizing Newton polytopes in a single seed. For any translation-invariant total order on the exponents, each least exponent $a$ that occurs determines a smallest Newton polytope $Q_a$. Choose one element with Newton polytope $Q_a$ and least term $x^a$ for each such $a$. These elements form a basis. In every reachable seed chart, every Gauss valuation takes a nonzero basis expansion to the minimum of its values on the nonzero summands. additions.title: Cluster-Crystal Realization of KR Cartan Algebras
additions.summary: We realize the Cartan algebras of restricted Kirillov--Reshetikhin modules as Cox rings of affine Schubert varieties, with Cartan degree given by the primitive divisor class. This yields upper cluster structures with non-inverted frozen variables for untwisted and diagram-twisted current algebras. In untwisted type, translation of the loop parameter gives a second cluster structure whose frozen variables are indexed by the affine Dynkin nodes. We construct charts adapted to the finite Chevalley operators and both shifted affine simple-root operators. additions.title: Crystal Structures on Theta Bases
additions.summary: Suppose the mutable part of a skew-symmetrizable seed admits a reddening sequence. We prove that the regular theta basis of the middle algebra is normalized perfect for the derivations attached to frozen sinks and sources reachable by mutation. Its $g$-vectors are the lattice points of a rational polyhedral cone in every seed. When $i$ is a sink, the theta function with index $g$ can be raised exactly $g_i$ times, and its highest nonzero divided derivative is again a theta function. additions.title: Schubert Cox Rings and Root Operators
additions.summary: We identify the Cox ring of every Schubert variety in a symmetrizable Kac--Moody partial flag variety with an upper cluster algebra whose frozen variables are not inverted. The construction also applies to Bott--Samelson varieties for arbitrary words and to their normal projective birational contractions that preserve the standard affine chart. A line-bundle recursion determines the boundary coefficients of the exchange relations.
